board-pack.name: Board Pack
board-pack.description: List agenda, exhibits, treasurer attachments, staff reports, and committee items for a named meeting date.

donor-list.name: Donor List
donor-list.description: Filter the donor export they provided and list holes; they communicate.

funder-gap.name: Funder Gap
funder-gap.description: Mark each required attachment present or missing from the award PDF and grant folder.

gift-ack-draft.name: Gift Ack Draft
gift-ack-draft.description: Draft acknowledgment letters from their approved template and gift file.

grant-deadlines.name: Grant Deadlines
grant-deadlines.description: List upcoming grant reports, draws, and closeouts from their sheet and award PDF.

grant-report.name: Grant Report
grant-report.description: Map funder template questions to program files and the grant financial export.

in-kind-list.name: In Kind List
in-kind-list.description: List in-kind rows from their log with holes; no fair-market values.

minutes-index.name: Minutes Index
minutes-index.description: Index meeting dates and draft versus adopted from their minutes folder.

restricted-ask.name: Restricted Ask
restricted-ask.description: List uncoded or ambiguous restricted-fund rows as questions for the bookkeeper.
